_comment: Tier-2 for poisson#3. REWRITTEN 2026-08-03 (deal.II 9.8.0-pre, Release build). The old fixture asserted the catalog's old Signal — 'the matrix is non-symmetric and CG breaks down at the first iteration' — by solving an unconstrained system under a 20-iteration budget and reporting the resulting SolverControl::NoConvergence. That proved nothing: the same budget fails with constraints too, and the premise is false. Measured reality on a manufactured-solution run (u = sin(pi x) sin(pi y), 5 adaptive cycles refining the lower-left quadrant, so hanging nodes at every cycle): omitting the hanging-node constraints leaves the matrix EXACTLY symmetric (max|A_ij - A_ji| / max|A| = 0), CG converges in the SAME iteration count as the constrained run (8/11/16/26/47/89), and only the answer degrades — the L2 error grows 3.04e-2 -> 6.74e-2 instead of falling to 1.35e-2. The fixture now asserts that silent-wrong signature and exits non-zero if any part of it stops reproducing.
